title: Good for age entry – TCS London Marathon
claims: Good For Age entry is open only to UK residents; the qualifying period is 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2025.

2026 Good For Age places are capped at 6,000 (3,000 men and 3,000 women); meeting the qualifying time only gives the opportunity to apply, and places are allocated fastest-first relative to age and qualifying time.

Qualifying times must come from an in-person certified marathon course (UKA, AIMS or national governing body); a MyWay-only qualification additionally requires an in-person half-marathon evidence time.
Applicants must provide a results webpage link, proof of age and proof of UK residence; GFA places cannot be deferred except for pregnancy or postpartum.
